```bash
nvidia-smi
```

```bash
ps aux | grep 934594 | grep -v grep
```

```bash
tail -20 ~/runs/xling_calib_direction/plan_002_v3.log 2>/dev/null
```

```bash
tmux list-sessions 2>/dev/null | grep plan_002_v3
```

```bash
tail -50 ~/runs/xling_calib_direction/plan_002_v3.log
```


Qwen3 有 94 层，每 4 层采样 = 24 个 probed layers × 20 语言 × ~14K 样本。
当前磁盘可用空间：
```bash
df -h /root/autodl-tmp/
du -sh /root/autodl-tmp/activations/ 2>/dev/null
```

**Part B**：Qwen3 模型完整性，run_plan_001.sh 内容摘要，磁盘空间评估

EVAL_DIR="${ACT_DIR}/for_eval"

    ln -sf "../${base}" "${EVAL_DIR}/${base/_train.pt/.pt}"
